name: biblio-catalog-source-smoke
comment: OL catalog source arc (plan 2026-08-15-biblio-openlibrary-catalog-source, Slice 6): prove the six-catalogue flip LIVE — the Discover picker carries Most Read + Classics, Explore renders all six house rails in fixed order, and the two Open Library rails hold real items with the plain Open Library attribution while popular keeps the combined house label. Live network against Apple + Open Library in a disposable session — never the daily pipe. Fresh tagged AppData means zero extensions, so the rail order is deterministic. Assertions use the plain-type automation rollups (catalogMenuKeysCsv / railKeysCsv / *RailCount / *FirstSource): the bridge's qml-get serializes QVariant conversions only, so the var-property models themselves read back as null.
